title: SDK Monitor
shortDescription: See every app's target SDK, and get told when an app changes it.
fullDescription:
SDK Monitor shows the target SDK of every installed app: the Android version each one is built for. Apps that target a newer version get Android's newer privacy and security protections; apps that lag behind don't.

• Every installed app with its target SDK, sorted and searchable
• A change log of every target SDK bump or drop
• A notification when an app changes its target SDK
• Each app's version history, minimum and target SDK side by side
• Light, dark and dynamic color, on phones, tablets and foldables
• Export to CSV

No account, no ads and no network access: nothing leaves your phone.
